sources.title: Context Window & VRAM: 4K vs 32K vs 128K Tokens (2026)
sources.snippet: How context length costs VRAM through the KV cache: what 4K, 8K, 32K and 128K add to an 8B model, how to set num_ctx in Ollama, and which size you need.

sources.title: Long Context RAG Performance of LLMs | Databricks Blog
sources.snippet: Longer context is not always optimal for RAG: Most model performance decreases after a certain context size. Notably, Llama-3.1-405b performance starts to decrease after 32k tokens, GPT-4-0125-preview starts to decrease after 64k tokens, and only a few models can maintain consistent long context RAG performance on all datasets.
